content: गोष्ठः, -ष्ठम् [गावस्तिष्ठन्त्यत्र घञ्र्थे क षत्वम्] (Usually गोष्ठम् only) .²1 A cow-pen, cow-house, cow-station. .²2 A station of cowherds. .²3 An abode, place of living; गोष्ठान् हरीणां गिरिसेतुमालाः <ls>Mb. 3. 177. 3</ls>. .{@-ष्ठः@} .²1 An assembly or meeting. .²2 An epithet of Śiva. .{@-ष्ठम्@} A purificatory श्राद्ध ceremony; वाच्यं गोष्ठे तु सुश्रुतम् <ls>Ms. 3. 254</ls>. ˚पतिः a chief herdsman. ˚वेदिका a mound or altar in a cow-pen. ˚श्वः a dog in a cow-pen which barks at every one; applied figuratively to a slanderous person, one who stays idly at home and slanders his neighbours. गोष्ठेपण्डितः ‘wise in a cow-pen’, a braggart, vain boaster. गोष्ठेक्ष्वेडिन् {%m.%} a boasting coward; also गोष्ठपटु, गोष्ठेप्रगल्भः, -शूरः <ab>&c.</ab>
